description: This file defines the LegacyRoleManager class which manages user roles within teams and organizations, including validation, permission checks, and role assignment, utilizing external services and database access.

classes.name: LegacyRoleManager
classes.description: A class implementing role management logic for teams and organizations, including validation, permission checks, and role assignment.

methods.name: validateRoleChange
methods.description: Validates whether a role change is permissible based on current roles and permissions.

methods.name: checkPermissionToChangeRole
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to change a role within a scope (organization or team).

methods.name: assignRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user within an organization.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Returns all available roles for an organization.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Returns all available roles for a team.
